SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_NO, ROOM_TYPE, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_IMG) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{roomType}, #{roomName}, #{roomImg})
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_NO, R.ROOM_TYPE, R.CREATE_DATE FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE R.ROOM_TYPE = 'DIRECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNoA} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNoB} ) AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO ) = 2 FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CM.MSG_NO, CM.ROOM_NO, CM.SENDER_NO, CASE WHEN CM.SENDER_NO = 0 THEN 'SYSTEM' ELSE TO_CHAR(M.MEMBER_NICKNAME) END AS SENDER, CASE WHEN CM.SENDER_NO = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(M.PROFILE_IMG) END AS SENDER_PROFILE_IMG, CM.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(CM.SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SEND_TIME FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CM.SENDER_NO WHERE CM.ROOM_NO = #{roomId} AND CM.MSG_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY CM.SEND_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 50 ORDER BY MSG_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MSG_NO, ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, CONTENT) VALUES (SEQ_CHAT_MSG_NO.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{senderNo}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_NO, R.ROOM_TYPE, CASE WHEN R.ROOM_TYPE = 'DIRECT' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(M.MEMBER_NICKNAME) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CRM.MEMBER_NO WHERE CRM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO AND CRM.MEMBER_NO != #{memberNo} AND ROWNUM = 1) ELSE R.ROOM_NAME END AS ROOM_NAME, CASE WHEN R.ROOM_TYPE = 'DIRECT' THEN (SELECT M.PROFILE_IMG FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CRM.MEMBER_NO WHERE CRM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO AND CRM.MEMBER_NO != #{memberNo} AND ROWNUM = 1) ELSE R.ROOM_IMG END AS ROOM_PROFILE_IMG, (SELECT CM.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO ORDER BY CM.MSG_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT TO_CHAR(CM.SEND_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO ORDER BY CM.MSG_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LAST_MESSAGE_TIME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO AND CM.SENDER_NO != #{memberNo} AND CM.READ_FL = 'N') AS UNREAD_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM ON CRM.ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO WHERE CRM.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ( SELECT MAX(MSG_NO) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_NO = R.ROOM_NO ) DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM ON CRM.ROOM_NO = CM.ROOM_NO WHERE CRM.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CM.SENDER_NO != #{memberNo} AND CM.READ_FL = 'N'
SELECT M.MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CRM.MEMBER_NO WHERE CRM.ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} ORDER BY M.MEMBER_NICKNAME ASC
SELECT M.MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER CRM JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CRM.MEMBER_NO WHERE CRM.ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} ORDER BY CRM.MEMBER_NO ASC
